-- Verificar se o abastecimento de R$28,46 do Vinicius está em bpo_charges
SELECT 
  id,
  client_email,
  client_name,
  type,
  value / 100 as valor_reais,
  status,
  due_date,
  asaas_charge_id,
  description,
  created_at
FROM bpo_charges
WHERE client_email = 'v6h2sw5vmn@privaterelay.appleid.com'
ORDER BY created_at DESC
LIMIT 20;
